case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: The pre-test, immediate post-test, and delayed post-test contained ten multiple-choice items closely related to IoT.
object_definition: Knowledge about the IoT subject represented by ten multiple-choice test items.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: The paper-based guidelines contained written assembly instructions; the MAR condition also displayed instructions alongside virtual component models.
object_definition: Codified step-by-step directions for assembling the IoT circuit.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: The paper-based guidelines contained images of the IoT components in addition to written assembly instructions.
object_definition: Codified visual representations of the components used in the paper manual.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: Participants became proficient in assembling the IoT components during the second evaluation phase, with reduced completion times in both groups.
object_definition: Hands-on ability to assemble the physical IoT circuit correctly and efficiently.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: The task required precise component placement, while the MAR animation guided accurate placement of real elements on the breadboard.
object_definition: Practical spatial know-how for selecting breadboard positions and placing or connecting components.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: Instructors demonstrated how to assemble the IoT circuit and supplied information related to IoT.
object_definition: Persons who demonstrated the target assembly procedure and explained relevant IoT information.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: Two subject matter experts separately reviewed the test items and agreed that they appropriately examined the target content.
object_definition: Experts who validated the content of the knowledge test.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: Forty participants completed all experimental phases and were assigned evenly to the MAR and paper groups.
object_definition: The forty university-level participants learning and performing the IoT assembly task.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: Before assisted assembly, instructors demonstrated how to assemble the circuit and provided IoT information.
object_definition: Human-led demonstration of the target assembly procedure and relevant subject information.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: Paper-group participants repeatedly referred to a book manual, alternating between reading instructions and performing each assembly step.
object_definition: Traditional learning intervention based on a printed book manual containing instructions and component images.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: Knowledge was assessed through a pre-test, an immediate post-test, and a delayed post-test one week later.
object_definition: The repeated pre-test, immediate post-test, and one-week delayed post-test used to assess knowledge gain and retention.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: The study developed and evaluated a MAR application that visualized IoT circuit assembly steps, provided 3D component models, and enabled interaction.
object_definition: Implemented mobile augmented-reality training practice for physical IoT circuit assembly.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: Virtual elements and step-by-step animation guided users in placing real elements accurately on the breadboard.
object_definition: Implemented MAR module presenting sequential instructions, component models, visual signals, and placement animation.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: The second main module allowed users to control IoT components after completing the circuit through commands sent via a web server.
object_definition: Implemented MAR module for controlling assembled LEDs, fans, and other IoT components.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: The study developed a Mobile Augmented Reality application to guide IoT circuit assembly.
object_definition: Augmented reality delivered through a mobile device for overlaying digital information on physical components.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: An iPad Pro was selected for computational power, large screen size, stable AR tracking, and user experience.
object_definition: Mobile hardware platform used to run the MAR application.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: The marker-based AR application was developed with Vuforia Engine to track image targets.
object_definition: Software engine used for image-target tracking in the MAR application.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: The application used marker-based tracking to support accurate rendering of 3D models during assembly.
object_definition: Tracking mechanism that anchors virtual content to an image target in the physical workspace.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: A QR code served as the AR marker and was placed on the breadboard to support accurate 3D model rendering.
object_definition: Physical image target used by the MAR application's tracking mechanism.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: The application used color-coded 3D models and animated virtual elements to guide wiring and component placement.
object_definition: Virtual component representations and motion sequences overlaid on the breadboard.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: Touch controls allowed users to navigate assembly steps with Next and Back buttons and control the visibility of wires and models.
object_definition: Touchscreen mechanism for navigating and manipulating MAR content.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: Both groups assembled a physical circuit containing a breadboard, NodeMCU, LEDs, rain sensor, fan, and servo motor.
object_definition: Physical assembly environment and components required to execute the training task.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: The authors attributed acquisition and one-week retention partly to participants spending approximately 20 to 25 minutes on the assembly task.
object_definition: Allocated task time considered sufficient in the experiment for participants to acquire the target knowledge.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: IoT circuit assembly was described as challenging because it involved intricate component arrangement and connectivity.
object_definition: Inherent assembly complexity involving numerous small components, connections, and precise locations.

node_name: attention switching between instructions and assembly
case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: Paper-group participants alternated between reading instructions and performing assembly, and the discussion states that the paper approach required switching attention between the task and instructions.
object_definition: Divided attention caused by repeatedly moving between the printed guide and the physical task.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: Participants found calculating connection slots from the paper diagram difficult because the physical circuit had no clear position indicator.
object_definition: Absence of directly aligned guidance showing the correct connection hole on the physical breadboard.

node_name: possible misunderstanding from words and diagrams alone
case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: Participants reported that paper instructions might be misunderstood when presented only through words and diagrams without animation or assembly-step visualization.
object_definition: Risk that static verbal and diagrammatic instructions will not be translated accurately into physical action.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: The authors state that participants may have experienced a learning curve when becoming familiar with AR technology.
object_definition: Initial familiarization effort required to use the MAR interface.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: The paper reports slight delays in the animation after button clicks and notes that users had to wait for dynamic visualizations to run.
object_definition: Delay between user input and completion of the assembly animation.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: Participants reported jittery imagery and alignment problems that affected judgment of component positions.
object_definition: Tracking instability causing virtual models to move or become misaligned with the physical breadboard.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: Participants reported that numerous virtual numbers overlapped the real image near the end of assembly and caused confusion.
object_definition: Visual clutter created when virtual numerical labels overlap the physical workspace.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: Participants could not recognize assembly mistakes, and the paper identifies error detection, feedback, and correction as usability concerns.
object_definition: Absence of automatic recognition and feedback for incorrect component connections.

node_name: limited validity of the repeated 10-question knowledge test
case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: The authors acknowledge that reusing ten shuffled questions may not remove familiarity effects and could affect the results.
object_definition: Threat to measurement validity caused by a small repeated item set and possible test familiarity.

case_title: Evaluating Knowledge Gain and Retention in IoT Circuit Assembly Using Mobile Augmented Reality Technology
evidence_statement: The forty participants were primarily university students in computer-science-related fields, and the authors caution against generalizing to other courses, ages, and cultural contexts.
object_definition: Restricted transferability arising from the small and demographically narrow participant sample and single IoT module.
